// diagnostic

E3114

`{subject}` carries a caller-chosen address to `{operation}`

What

`{subject}` carries a caller-chosen address to `{operation}`

Why

Code outside the kernel files reaches `{subject}` without a gate, so the address `{operation}` uses would skip the kernel's audit.

Fix

Take an owner or a `View<T>` instead of the address, make the field `priv`, or mark the function `#Unsafe("…")` so each caller vouches for the address.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E3114: tests/ui/E3114_raw_address_into_kernel/stderr.

Error [jet.RawAddressIntoKernel]: `_peek` carries the caller-chosen address `address` to `pointer_from_address`
  --> tests/ui/E3114_raw_address_into_kernel/run.jet:9:18
    |
  9 |         pointer: mem.Ptr<Int>.from_addr(address)
    |                  ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: Code outside the kernel files calls `_peek` without a gate, so the address `pointer_from_address` uses would skip the kernel's audit.
 Fix: Take an owner or a `View<T>` in place of `address`, or mark `_peek` `#Unsafe("…")` so each caller vouches for the address.
